item.text:
**Bottom line**
- 6B.1 is **mixed, leaning positive**. AMLO’s 2024 record shows a real, repeated welfare-centered agenda: health care, poverty relief, Indigenous rights, women’s protection, migrant-child services, and direct social transfers. The main caveat is that some of this was wrapped in self-congratulation and election-timed cash-flow management, so the welfare focus was genuine but not cleanly separated from propaganda and patronage.

**Claims**
- [Bienestar, salud, obras y basificación a personal educativo y médico, prioridades en último tramo de la 4T: presidente](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/bienestar-salud-obras-y-basificacion-a-personal-educativo-y-medico-prioridades-en-ultimo-tramo-de-la-4t-presidente/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-01-02: AMLO said the final stretch prioritized free universal health care, public works, and better pay/status for teachers and health workers. IDs: `6B.1`, `5B.6`

- [27-02-24 versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/27-02-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-02-27: The government said it had invested in 6,611 health centers with upgrades and equipment, especially in poorer areas. IDs: `6B.1`, `5B.6`

- [Iniciativa de reforma constitucional sobre derechos de los pueblos indígenas y afromexicano](https://www.gob.mx/inpi/documentos/iniciativa-de-reforma-constitucional-sobre-derechos-de-los-pueblos-indigenas-y-afromexicano-357107) | INPI | 2024-02-05: The executive-backed reform promised recognition, self-determination, direct budget authority, consultation rights, and explicit protections for Indigenous and Afro-Mexican communities. IDs: `6B.1`, `5B.8`

- [Anuncia DIF Nacional acciones de protección a niñez migrante](https://www.gob.mx/difnacional/articulos/anuncia-dif-nacional-acciones-de-proteccion-a-ninez-migrante) | Sistema Nacional DIF | 2024-06-17: DIF said it had 88 active centers for migrant children and families, which is concrete welfare protection for a highly vulnerable group. IDs: `6B.1`, `5B.8`

- [Se refuerza estrategia contra la violencia hacia las mujeres y niñas: SSPC](https://www.gob.mx/sspc/prensa/se-refuerza-estrategia-contra-la-violencia-hacia-las-mujeres-y-ninas-sspc) | SSPC | 2024-08

**Bottom line**
- 6B.1 is **mixed, leaning positive**. AMLO’s 2024 record shows a real welfare-centered agenda: health access, Indigenous and migrant protections, and women’s protection. The main caveat is that some benefits were wrapped in self-congratulation and election-timed cash transfers, so welfare was a core theme, but not always cleanly separated from political promotion.

**Accepted claims**
- [Bienestar, salud, obras y basificación a personal educativo y médico, prioridades en último tramo de la 4T: presidente](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/bienestar-salud-obras-y-basificacion-a-personal-educativo-y-medico-prioridades-en-ultimo-tramo-de-la-4t-presidente/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-01-02  
  AMLO said the final stretch prioritized free universal health care, public works, and better pay/status for teachers and health workers. This is direct evidence that human welfare was treated as a central purpose of rule.  
  IDs: `6B.1`, `5B.6`

- [27-02-24 versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/27-02-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-02-27  
  The government said it had invested in 6,611 health centers with infrastructure upgrades and medical equipment, especially in poorer areas. That is concrete welfare-oriented spending, not just rhetoric.  
  IDs: `6B.1`, `5B.6`

- [Reforma en materia de pueblos indígenas y afromexicanos es un acto de justicia social](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/reforma-en-materia-de-pueblos-indigenas-y-afromexicanos-es-un-acto-de-justicia-social/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-02-21  
  The executive-backed reform promised recognition, self-determination, direct budget authority, consultation rights, and protections for Indigenous and Afro-Mexican communities. This is strong evidence that welfare for marginalized groups was a core governing objective.  
  IDs: `6B.1`, `5B.8`

- [Anuncia DIF Nacional acciones de protección a niñez migrante](https://www.gob.mx/difnacional/articulos/anuncia-dif-nacional-acciones-de-proteccion-a-ninez-migrante) | Sistema Nacional DIF | 2024-06-17  
  DIF said it had 88 active centers for migrant children and families. That is tangible protection for a highly vulnerable group, supporting a welfare-first reading.  
  IDs: `6B.1`, `5B.8`

- [Se refuerza estrategia contra la violencia hacia las mujeres y niñas: SSPC](https://www.gob.mx/sspc/prensa/se-refuerza-estrategia-contra-la-violencia-hacia-las-mujeres-y-ninas-sspc) | SSPC | 2024-08-06  
  The federal government said it was reinforcing anti-violence policy for women and girls through outreach and training. Even if the reported feminicide drop is an official claim, the policy focus itself is welfare-centered.  
  IDs: `6B.1`, `5B.8`

- [200 puntos del sexto informe de gobierno](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/200-puntos-del-sexto-informe-de-gobierno/) | Presidencia de México | 2024-09-01  
  AMLO’s Sixth Report claimed large poverty reduction, higher minimum wages in real terms, restored Indigenous lands and water, and expanded pensions, disability support, and scholarships. This is self-reporting, but it reinforces the administration’s welfare-first framing.  
  IDs: `6B.1`, `5B.10`, `5B.7`

- [Mexico and the U.S. agreed to clamp down on illegal immigration, leaders say](https://theprint.in/world/us-mexico-to-clamp-down-on-illegal-immigration-leaders-say/2062785/) | Reuters | 2024-04-30  
  Mexico paired migration controls with explicit human-rights language. That is limited but real evidence that the government did not treat migrants purely as a security problem.  
  IDs: `6B.1`, `5B.9`, `5B.8`

**Negative evidence**
- [Evita fraudes, no hay entrega de apoyos durante el proceso electoral](https://programasparaelbienestar.gob.mx/evita-fraudes-no-hay-entrega-de-apoyos-durante-el-proceso-electoral/) | Programas para el Bienestar | 2024-03-18  
  Welfare payments were advanced before the electoral blackout, which makes the timing look at least partly patronage-sensitive and electorally strategic. This undercuts a pure welfare-first interpretation.  
  IDs: `6B.1`, `5B.7`, `5B.8`

- [Ninguna forma de discriminación racial debe existir](https://www.gob.mx/segob/prensa/ninguna-forma-de-discriminacion-racial-debe-existir?idiom=en) | Secretaría de Gobernación / CONAPRED | 2024-03-21  
  The government itself acknowledged barriers such as racial profiling, arbitrary detentions, invisibility of Afro-Mexicans, and obstacles to identity documents for Indigenous, migrant, and ethnic-minority people. That is evidence welfare protection was incomplete and uneven.  
  IDs: `6B.1`, `5B.8`

- [World Report 2024: Mexico](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico) | Human Rights Watch | 2024  
  HRW said migrants are preyed upon, checkpoints disproportionately affect Indigenous and Afro-Mexican people, and women with disabilities face disproportionate violence. This is strong evidence against a fully welfare-centered state.  
  IDs: `6B.1`, `5B.8`

- [Mexico's military role in migrant massacre comes under sharp scrutiny](https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexico-militarys-role-in-migrant-massacre-comes-under-sharp-scrutiny-2024-10-16/) | Reuters | 2024-10-16  
  Reuters reported soldiers killed six migrants. That is direct evidence that vulnerable people were not protected with equal seriousness.  
  IDs: `6B.1`, `5B.8`

**Search gap**
- I found **strong official evidence of welfare-oriented policy design**, but **less independent 2024 evidence proving outcomes matched the rhetoric**.
- The clearest negative evidence is not that welfare was absent, but that it was **mixed with patronage timing, uneven protection for vulnerable groups, and continuing violence**.
- So the best reading is: welfare was a genuine governing purpose, but not a pure one.
